title: Delete Your Account
intro: This page explains how to delete your FinBrief account and what happens to your data. You can do it yourself from inside the app in under a minute.

sections.heading: Delete it from the app
sections.body:
1. Open FinBrief and sign in.
2. Go to the Profile tab.
3. Scroll to the bottom and tap "Delete Account".
4. Confirm on the dialog that appears.

Deletion happens immediately and cannot be undone.

sections.heading: If you cannot sign in
sections.body:
Email us from the address on the account and we will delete it for you. Requests are actioned within 30 days.

Contact: instaflow38@gmail.com

Please include the email address you registered with, so we can identify the right account.

sections.heading: What is deleted
sections.body:
Your account and login credentials.

Your profile, plan and credit balance.

Your bookmarks, watchlist and portfolio holdings.

Your saved notifications, purchase records and submitted feedback.

Your AI request history.

All of this is removed permanently and cannot be restored.

sections.heading: What is kept, and for how long
sections.body:
Anonymous, aggregated analytics and crash reports that are not linked to your account may be retained by Google Analytics and Crashlytics under their own retention periods.

Cached news articles are not personal data and are deleted automatically after 30 days regardless of account activity.

Where we are required by law to keep a record of a transaction, that record is kept for as long as the law requires and for no other purpose.

sections.heading: Subscriptions
sections.body:
Deleting your FinBrief account does NOT cancel a Google Play subscription. Cancel it separately in the Google Play Store under Payments & subscriptions, otherwise billing continues.

Refunds are handled by Google Play under their policy, not by us.
